{{Quote|Excuse me? Who is this? What happened to Bravo Team?|Rugenth|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Rugenth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held the rank of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Serving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]], Rugenth dispatched [[Bravo Team (Quesh)|Bravo Team]] to destroy a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] convoy. Athough they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] before they finished the mission, other Imperials in the area completed the assignment and reported success to Rugenth.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moff Rugenth appears on Quesh in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], where he gives Imperial players the mission "Walker Tripping." Rugenth's role in the mission was originally filled by Moff Dracen; Rugenth's NPC is still labeled as ''moff_dracen'' within the game's files.<ref name="TOR" />
